| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Modify](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Modify) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Organization](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Organization) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Person](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Person) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Plan](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Plan) | class | There exist no prescriptive requirement on the nature of plans, their representation, the actions or steps they consist of, or their intended goals. Since plans may evolve over time, it may become necessary to track their provenance, so plans themselves are entities. Representing the plan explicitly in the provenance can be useful for various tasks: for example, to validate the execution as represented in the provenance record, to manage expectation failures, or to provide explanations. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [PrimarySource](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#PrimarySource) | class | An instance of prov:PrimarySource provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:hadPrimarySource relation from some secondary prov:Entity to an earlier, primary prov:Entity. For example, :blog prov:hadPrimarySource :newsArticle; prov:qualifiedPrimarySource [ a prov:PrimarySource; prov:entity :newsArticle; :foo :bar ] . |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Publish](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Publish) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Publisher](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Publisher) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Quotation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Quotation) | class | An instance of prov:Quotation provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:wasQuotedFrom relation from some taken prov:Entity from an earlier, larger prov:Entity. For example, :here_is_looking_at_you_kid prov:wasQuotedFrom :casablanca_script; prov:qualifiedQuotation [ a prov:Quotation; prov:entity :casablanca_script; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Removal](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Removal) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Replace](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Replace) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Revision](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Revision) | class | An instance of prov:Revision provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:wasRevisionOf relation from some newer prov:Entity to an earlier prov:Entity. For example, :draft_2 prov:wasRevisionOf :draft_1; prov:qualifiedRevision [ a prov:Revision; prov:entity :draft_1; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [RightsAssignment](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#RightsAssignment) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [RightsHolder](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#RightsHolder) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Role](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Role) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [ServiceDescription](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#ServiceDescription) | class | Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [SoftwareAgent](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#SoftwareAgent) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Start](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Start) | class | An instance of prov:Start provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:wasStartedBy relation from some started prov:Activity to an prov:Entity that started it. For example, :foot_race prov:wasStartedBy :bang; prov:qualifiedStart [ a prov:Start; prov:entity :bang; :foo :bar; prov:atTime '2012-03-09T08:05:08-05:00'^^xsd:dateTime ] . |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Submit](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Submit) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [Usage](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#Usage) | class | An instance of prov:Usage provides additional descriptions about the binary prov:used relation from some prov:Activity to an prov:Entity that it used. For example, :keynote prov:used :podium; prov:qualifiedUsage [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :podium; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [actedOnBehalfOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#actedOnBehalfOf) | object_property | An object property to express the accountability of an agent towards another agent. The subordinate agent acted on behalf of the responsible agent in an actual activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [activity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#activity) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [agent](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#agent) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [alternateOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#alternateOf) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [asInBundle](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#asInBundle) | object_property | prov:asInBundle is used to specify which bundle the general entity of a prov:mentionOf property is described.<br><br>When :x prov:mentionOf :y and :y is described in Bundle :b, the triple :x prov:asInBundle :b is also asserted to cite the Bundle in which :y was described. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [atLocation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#atLocation) | object_property | The Location of any resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [atTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#atTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an InstantaneousEvent occurred, in the form of xsd:dateTime. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [derivedByInsertionFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#derivedByInsertionFrom) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [derivedByRemovalFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#derivedByRemovalFrom) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [describesService](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#describesService) | object_property | relates a generic provenance query service resource (type prov:ServiceDescription) to a specific query service description (e.g. a prov:DirectQueryService or a sd:Service). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [dictionary](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#dictionary) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [endedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#endedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an activity ended. See also prov:startedAtTime. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [entity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#entity) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [generated](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#generated) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [generatedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#generatedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an entity was completely created and is available for use. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadActivity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadActivity) | object_property | This property has multiple RDFS domains to suit multiple OWL Profiles. See <a href="#owl-profile">PROV-O OWL Profile</a>. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadDictionaryMember](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadDictionaryMember) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadGeneration](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadGeneration) | object_property | The _optional_ Generation involved in an Entity's Derivation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadMember](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadMember) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadPlan](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadPlan) | object_property | The _optional_ Plan adopted by an Agent in Association with some Activity. Plan specifications are out of the scope of this specification. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadPrimarySource](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadPrimarySource) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadRole](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadRole) | object_property | The _optional_ Role that an Entity assumed in the context of an Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon; prov:qualified [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :spoon; prov:hadRole roles:mixing_implement ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [hadUsage](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#hadUsage) | object_property | The _optional_ Usage involved in an Entity's Derivation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [has_anchor](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#has_anchor) | object_property | Indicates anchor URI for a potentially dynamic resource instance. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [has_provenance](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#has_provenance) | object_property | Indicates a provenance-URI for a resource; the resource identified by this property presents a provenance record about its subject or anchor resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [has_query_service](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#has_query_service) | object_property | Indicates a provenance query service that can access provenance related to its subject or anchor resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [influenced](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#influenced) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [influencer](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#influencer) | object_property | Subproperties of prov:influencer are used to cite the object of an unqualified PROV-O triple whose predicate is a subproperty of prov:wasInfluencedBy (e.g. prov:used, prov:wasGeneratedBy). prov:influencer is used much like rdf:object is used. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [insertedKeyEntityPair](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#insertedKeyEntityPair) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [invalidated](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#invalidated) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [invalidatedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#invalidatedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an entity was invalidated (i.e., no longer usable). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [mentionOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#mentionOf) | object_property | prov:mentionOf is used to specialize an entity as described in another bundle. It is to be used in conjuction with prov:asInBundle.<br><br>prov:asInBundle is used to cite the Bundle in which the generalization was mentioned. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [pairEntity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#pairEntity) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [pairKey](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#pairKey) | datatype_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [pingback](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#pingback) | object_property | Relates a resource to a provenance pingback service that may receive additional provenance links about the resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [provenanceUriTemplate](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#provenanceUriTemplate) | datatype_property | Relates a provenance service to a URI template string for constructing provenance-URIs. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedAssociation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedAssociation) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasAssociatedWith Agent :ag, then it can qualify the Association using prov:qualifiedAssociation [ a prov:Association; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedAttribution](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedAttribution) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasAttributedTo Agent :ag, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedAttribution [ a prov:Attribution; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedCommunication](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedCommunication) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasInformedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedCommunication [ a prov:Communication; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedDelegation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedDelegation) | object_property | If this Agent prov:actedOnBehalfOf Agent :ag, then it can qualify how with prov:qualifiedResponsibility [ a prov:Responsibility; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedDerivation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedDerivation) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasDerivedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was derived using prov:qualifiedDerivation [ a prov:Derivation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedEnd](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedEnd) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasEndedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was ended using prov:qualifiedEnd [ a prov:End; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedGeneration](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedGeneration) | object_property | If this Activity prov:generated Entity :e, then it can qualify how it performed the Generation using prov:qualifiedGeneration [ a prov:Generation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedInfluence](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedInfluence) | object_property | Because prov:qualifiedInfluence is a broad relation, the more specific relations (qualifiedCommunication, qualifiedDelegation, qualifiedEnd, etc.) should be used when applicable. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedInsertion](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedInsertion) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedInvalidation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedInvalidation) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasInvalidatedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was invalidated using prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedPrimarySource](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedPrimarySource) | object_property | If this Entity prov:hadPrimarySource Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedPrimarySource [ a prov:PrimarySource; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedQuotation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedQuotation) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasQuotedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedQuotation [ a prov:Quotation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedRemoval](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedRemoval) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedRevision](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedRevision) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasRevisionOf Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was revised using prov:qualifiedRevision [ a prov:Revision; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedStart](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedStart) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasStartedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was started using prov:qualifiedStart [ a prov:Start; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [qualifiedUsage](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#qualifiedUsage) | object_property | If this Activity prov:used Entity :e, then it can qualify how it used it using prov:qualifiedUsage [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [removedKey](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#removedKey) | datatype_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [specializationOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#specializationOf) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [startedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#startedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an activity started. See also prov:endedAtTime. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [used](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#used) | object_property | A prov:Entity that was used by this prov:Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon, :egg, :oven . |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [value](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#value) | datatype_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasAssociatedWith](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAssociatedWith) | object_property | An prov:Agent that had some (unspecified) responsibility for the occurrence of this prov:Activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasAttributedTo](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasAttributedTo) | object_property | Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasDerivedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom) | object_property | The more specific subproperties of prov:wasDerivedFrom (i.e., prov:wasQuotedFrom, prov:wasRevisionOf, prov:hadPrimarySource) should be used when applicable. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasEndedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasEndedBy) | object_property | End is when an activity is deemed to have ended. An end may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that terminated the activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasGeneratedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasGeneratedBy) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasInfluencedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasInfluencedBy) | object_property | Because prov:wasInfluencedBy is a broad relation, its more specific subproperties (e.g. prov:wasInformedBy, prov:actedOnBehalfOf, prov:wasEndedBy, etc.) should be used when applicable. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasInformedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasInformedBy) | object_property | An activity a2 is dependent on or informed by another activity a1, by way of some unspecified entity that is generated by a1 and used by a2. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasInvalidatedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasInvalidatedBy) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasQuotedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasQuotedFrom) | object_property | An entity is derived from an original entity by copying, or 'quoting', some or all of it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasRevisionOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasRevisionOf) | object_property | A revision is a derivation that revises an entity into a revised version. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#` | [wasStartedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasStartedBy) | object_property | Start is when an activity is deemed to have started. A start may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that initiated the activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/hydra/core#` | [Error](http://www.w3.org/ns/hydra/core#Error) | class | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [ChangeEvent](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/ChangeEvent) | class | Rappresenta un evento risultato essere un importante cambiamento per un'organizzazione come ad esempio una fusione o una riorganizzazione. È pensato per quelle situazioni in cui l'organizzazione risultante si distingue da quella originale sufficientemente da essere rappresentata con una URI differente. Le estensioni del vocabolario dovrebbero definire le sotto-classi per esprimere particolari categorie di eventi. L'istante o l'intervallo in cui l'evento accade dovrebbe essere espresso tramite `prov:startAtTime` e`prov:endedAtTime`. Una descrizione dovrebbe essere fornita attraverso `dct:description`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [FormalOrganization](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/FormalOrganization) | class | 関連する権利と責任を有する（特に法的管轄区域において）世界中に広く認識されている組織。例には、企業、慈善団体、政府や教会が含まれます。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [Membership](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/Membership) | class | Indique la nature de l'engagement d'un Agent dans une Organisation. Représente une relation n-aire entre un Agent, une Organisation et un Role. Il est possible d'indiquer directement l'appartenance à une organisation, independemment d'un rôle spécifique, à travers l'usage de la propriété `org:memberOf`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [Organization](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/Organization) | class | Grupo de personas que se organiza en una comunidad u otro tipo de estructura social, comercial o política. Dicho grupo tiene un objetivo o motivo común para su existencia que va más allá del conjunto de personas que lo forman y que puede actuar como “agente”. A menudo las organizaciones se pueden agrupar en estructuras jerárquicas. Se recomienda el uso de etiquetas de SKOS para denominar a cada “organización”. En concreto, `skos:prefLabel` para la denominación principal o recomendada (aquella reconocida legalmente, siempre que sea posible), `skos:altLabel` para denominaciones alternativas (nombre comercial, sigla, denominación por la que se conoce a la organización coloquialmente) y `skos:notation` para referirse al código que identifique a la organización en una lista de códigos. Denominaciones alternativas: _colectivo_ _corporación_ _grupo_ |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [OrganizationalCollaboration](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/OrganizationalCollaboration) | class | A collaboration between two or more Organizations such as a project. It meets the criteria for being an Organization in that it has an identity and defining purpose independent of its particular members but is neither a formally recognized legal entity nor a sub-unit within some larger organization. Might typically have a shorter lifetime than the Organizations within it, but not necessarily. All members are `org:Organization`s rather than individuals and those Organizations can play particular roles within the venture. Alternative names: _Project_ _Venture_ _Endeavour_ _Consortium_ _Endeavour_ |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [OrganizationalUnit](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/OrganizationalUnit) | class | Une organisation telle que le support informatique d'une université, qui fait partie d'une Organisation Formelle plus importante et qui ne peut être reconnue qu'en tant que membre de cette organisation supérieure, ce n'est pas une entité légale en elle-même. Les unités opérationnelles peuvent être étendues, complexes et inclure elles-mêmes d'autres branches ou Unités Opérationnelles, voire des Organisations Formelles. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [Post](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/Post) | class | Un Impiego rappresenta una posizione all'interno dell'organizzazione che esiste indipendentemente dalla persona che la ricopre. Gli impieghi possono essere utilizzati per le situazioni in cui una persona è membro di un'organizzazione o di un ufficio (ad esempio un segretario di stato). Un Impiego può essere ricoperto da più persone. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [Role](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/Role) | class | Denotes a role that a Person or other Agent can take in an organization. Instances of this class describe the abstract role; to denote a specific instance of a person playing that role in a specific organization use an instance of `org:Membership`. It is common for roles to be arranged in some taxonomic structure and we use SKOS to represent that. The normal SKOS lexical properties should be used when labelling the Role. Additional descriptive properties for the Role, such as a Salary band, may be added by extension vocabularies. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [Site](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/Site) | class | An office or other premise at which the organization is located. Many organizations are spread across multiple sites and many sites will host multiple locations. In most cases a Site will be a physical location. However, we don't exclude the possibility of non-physical sites such as a virtual office with an associated post box and phone reception service. Extensions may provide subclasses to denote particular types of site. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [basedAt](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/basedAt) | object_property | Indique le site sur lequel une personne est basée. Nous ne limitons pas le nombre de sites sur lesquels une personne peut être basée. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [changedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/changedBy) | object_property | Evento de cambio que resulta en una modificación en la organización. Dependiendo del evento, la organización puede dejar de existir tras el cambio. Es la relación inversa de `org:originalOrganization`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [classification](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/classification) | object_property | Ordenación jerárquica que se hace de una organización dentro de un esquema de clasificación. Es posible que algunos vocabularios especifiquen esta propiedad de forma que el rango se corresponda con un `skos:ConceptScheme` específico. La conveniencia de incluir esta propiedad se está debatiendo y puede que se revise o elimine (en muchos casos las organizaciones se clasifican mejor si se define una jerarquía de subclases en un vocabulario aparte) |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasMember](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasMember) | object_property | 対象組織のメンバーであるエージェント（人または他の組織）を示します。org:memberOfの逆。さらに明確な説明については、そのプロパティーを参照してください。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasMembership](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasMembership) | object_property | Indicates a membership relationship that the Agent plays. Inverse of `org:member`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasPost](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasPost) | object_property | Indicates a Post which exists within the Organization. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasPrimarySite](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasPrimarySite) | object_property | Oficina principal de la organización, la opción por defecto para ponerse en contacto con una organización, aunque no corresponde necesariamente con las oficinas centrales de la organización. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasRegisteredSite](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasRegisteredSite) | object_property | Oficina o sede legalmente registrada de la organización. En muchas jurisdicciones legales existe el requisito de que organizaciones formales tales como empresas u organizaciones de beneficencia tengan una sede principal de este tipo. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasSite](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasSite) | object_property | Indique un site sur lequel l'Organisation possède une présence, même indirecte (domiciliation, boite postale). Inverse de `org:siteOf`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasSubOrganization](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasSubOrganization) | object_property | 組織または組織単位の階層的包含を表わします。この組織のサブパートまたは子である組織を示します。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [hasUnit](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/hasUnit) | object_property | Indique une Unité qui fait partie d'une Organisation, par exemple un Départment au sein d'une Organisation Formelle plus large. Inverse de `org:unitOf`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [headOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/headOf) | object_property | Indicates that a person is the leader or formal head of the Organization. This will normally mean that they are the root of the `org:reportsTo` (acyclic) graph, though an organization may have more than one head. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [heldBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/heldBy) | object_property | Indicate un Agent qui occupe le Poste. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [holds](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/holds) | object_property | Indica un Impiego ricoperto da un Agent. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [identifier](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/identifier) | datatype_property | Gives an identifier, such as a company registration number, that can be used to used to uniquely identify the organization. Many different national and international identier schemes are available. The org ontology is neutral to which schemes are used. The particular identifier scheme should be indicated by the datatype of the identifier value. Using datatypes to distinguish the notation scheme used is consistent with recommended best practice for `skos:notation` of which this property is a specialization. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [linkedTo](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/linkedTo) | object_property | Indica una relazione arbitraria tra due organizzazioni. Ad esempio, specializzazioni di questa proprietà possono essere usate per denotare relazioni particolari tipo il finanziamento o la fornitura. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [location](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/location) | datatype_property | Lugar o ubicación exacta de una persona en una organización con el objetivo de facilitar, por ejemplo, la entrega de correo. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [member](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/member) | object_property | Persona (u otro agente, incluyendo una organización) que participa en la relación de membresía. Es la relación inversa de `org:hasMembership`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [memberDuring](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/memberDuring) | object_property | 構成員が有効である／であった期間を示すためのオプションのプロパティー。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [memberOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/memberOf) | object_property | Indique qu'une personne est membre de l'Organisation sans précision sur la nature de cet engagement ou du rôle joué. Notez que le choix du nom de cette propriété ne vise pas à la limiter aux seuls engagements formels, elle peut également couvrir des concepts reliés comme l'affiliation ou le bénévolat. Des extensions peuvent spécialiser cette relation pour indiquer des rôles particuliers au sein de l'Organisation or des relations plus nuancées avec elle. Possède une propriété inverse optionnelle, `org:hasmember`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [organization](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/organization) | object_property | Indique l'Organization dont l'agent est membre. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [originalOrganization](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/originalOrganization) | object_property | 変更のきっかけとなった出来事以前に存在した1つ以上の組織を示します。出来事によって、出来事の後にそれらは存在し続けたかも、存在し続けなかったかもしれません。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [postIn](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/postIn) | object_property | ポストが存在する組織を示します。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [remuneration](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/remuneration) | object_property | Indica il salario o altra forma di remunerazione associata al ruolo. In genere, questo si denota usando uno schema di rappresentazione esistente come il `gr:PriceSpecification` ma il codominio è lasciato libero di essere specializzato a seconda delle applicazioni. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [reportsTo](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/reportsTo) | object_property | Indicates a reporting relationship as might be depicted on an organizational chart. The precise semantics of the reporting relationship will vary by organization but is intended to encompass both direct supervisory relationships (e.g. carrying objective and salary setting authority) and more general reporting or accountability relationships (e.g. so called _dotted line_ reporting). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [resultedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/resultedFrom) | object_property | Indica l'evento che ha permesso all'organizzazione di instaurarsi. È l'inverso di `org:resultingOrganization`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [resultingOrganization](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/resultingOrganization) | object_property | 出来事の結果、作成、変更された組織を示します。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [role](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/role) | object_property | Actividad que el agente desempeña en una relación de pertenencia a una organización. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [siteAddress](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/siteAddress) | object_property | Indique une adresse pour le site dans un encodage approprié. L'usage du vocabulaire vCard ( http://www.w3.org/TR/vcard-rdf/) est encouragé, mais le range est ouvert pour permettre l'utilisation d'autres vocabulaires. L'adresse peut comporter le courriel, le téléphone, et l'information de géolocalisation; et n'est donc pas seulement limitée à une adresse physique. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [siteOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/siteOf) | object_property | あるサイトである存在感を持っている組織を示します。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [subOrganizationOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/subOrganizationOf) | object_property | 組織または組織単位の階層的包含を表わします。この組織を含む組織を示します。 |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [transitiveSubOrganizationOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/transitiveSubOrganizationOf) | object_property | È la chiusura transitiva di subOrganizationOf, quindi rappresenta tutte le organizzazioni che la contengono. Tecnicamente, essendo una chiusura transitiva, può contenere asserzioni che non la riguardano e quindi il suo uso è sconsigliato. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/org/` | [unitOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/org/unitOf) | object_property | Indique l'Organisation dont cette Organisation ou Unité fait partie, par exemple un Départment au sein d'une Organisation Formelle plus large. Inverse de `org:hasUnit`. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Accept](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Accept) | class | Activity that identifies the acceptance of a resource (e.g., an article in a conference) |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Activity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Activity) | class | An activity is something that occurs over a period of time and acts upon or with entities; it may include consuming, processing, transforming, modifying, relocating, using, or generating entities. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [ActivityInfluence](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/ActivityInfluence) | class | ActivitiyInfluence is the capacity of an activity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of generation, invalidation, communication, or other. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Agent](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Agent) | class | An agent is something that bears some form of responsibility for an activity taking place, for the existence of an entity, or for another agent's activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [AgentInfluence](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/AgentInfluence) | class | AgentInfluence is the capacity of an agent to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of attribution, association, delegation, or other. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Association](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Association) | class | An activity association is an assignment of responsibility to an agent for an activity, indicating that the agent had a role in the activity. It further allows for a plan to be specified, which is the plan intended by the agent to achieve some goals in the context of this activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Attribution](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Attribution) | class | Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent.<br><br>When an entity e is attributed to agent ag, entity e was generated by some unspecified activity that in turn was associated to agent ag. Thus, this relation is useful when the activity is not known, or irrelevant. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Bundle](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Bundle) | class | A bundle is a named set of provenance descriptions, and is itself an Entity, so allowing provenance of provenance to be expressed. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Collection](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Collection) | class | A collection is an entity that provides a structure to some constituents, which are themselves entities. These constituents are said to be member of the collections. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Communication](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Communication) | class | Communication is the exchange of an entity by two activities, one activity using the entity generated by the other. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Contribute](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Contribute) | class | Activity that identifies any contribution of an agent to a resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Contributor](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Contributor) | class | Role with the function of having responsibility for making contributions to a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Modify or Create Activities |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Copyright](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Copyright) | class | Activity that identifies the Copyrighting activity associated to a resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Create](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Create) | class | Activity that identifies the creation of a resource |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Creator](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Creator) | class | Role with the function of creating a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Create Activity |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Delegation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Delegation) | class | Delegation is the assignment of authority and responsibility to an agent (by itself or by another agent) to carry out a specific activity as a delegate or representative, while the agent it acts on behalf of retains some responsibility for the outcome of the delegated work.<br><br>For example, a student acted on behalf of his supervisor, who acted on behalf of the department chair, who acted on behalf of the university; all those agents are responsible in some way for the activity that took place but we do not say explicitly who bears responsibility and to what degree. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Derivation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Derivation) | class | A derivation is a transformation of an entity into another, an update of an entity resulting in a new one, or the construction of a new entity based on a pre-existing entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Dictionary](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Dictionary) | class | A dictionary is an entity that provides a structure to some constituents, which are themselves entities. These constituents are said to be member of the dictionary. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [DirectQueryService](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/DirectQueryService) | class | Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [EmptyCollection](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/EmptyCollection) | class | An empty collection is a collection without members. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [EmptyDictionary](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/EmptyDictionary) | class | An empty dictionary (i.e. has no members). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [End](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/End) | class | End is when an activity is deemed to have been ended by an entity, known as trigger. The activity no longer exists after its end. Any usage, generation, or invalidation involving an activity precedes the activity's end. An end may refer to a trigger entity that terminated the activity, or to an activity, known as ender that generated the trigger. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Entity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Entity) | class | An entity is a physical, digital, conceptual, or other kind of thing with some fixed aspects; entities may be real or imaginary. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [EntityInfluence](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/EntityInfluence) | class | EntityInfluence is the capacity of an entity to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of usage, start, end, derivation, or other. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Generation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Generation) | class | Generation is the completion of production of a new entity by an activity. This entity did not exist before generation and becomes available for usage after this generation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Influence](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Influence) | class | Influence is the capacity of an entity, activity, or agent to have an effect on the character, development, or behavior of another by means of usage, start, end, generation, invalidation, communication, derivation, attribution, association, or delegation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Insertion](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Insertion) | class | Insertion is a derivation that describes the transformation of a dictionary into another, by insertion of one or more key-entity pairs. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [InstantaneousEvent](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/InstantaneousEvent) | class | The PROV data model is implicitly based on a notion of instantaneous events (or just events), that mark transitions in the world. Events include generation, usage, or invalidation of entities, as well as starting or ending of activities. This notion of event is not first-class in the data model, but it is useful for explaining its other concepts and its semantics. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Invalidation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Invalidation) | class | Invalidation is the start of the destruction, cessation, or expiry of an existing entity by an activity. The entity is no longer available for use (or further invalidation) after invalidation. Any generation or usage of an entity precedes its invalidation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [KeyEntityPair](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/KeyEntityPair) | class | A key-entity pair. Part of a prov:Dictionary through prov:hadDictionaryMember. The key is any RDF Literal, the value is a prov:Entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Location](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Location) | class | A location can be an identifiable geographic place (ISO 19112), but it can also be a non-geographic place such as a directory, row, or column. As such, there are numerous ways in which location can be expressed, such as by a coordinate, address, landmark, and so forth. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Modify](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Modify) | class | Activity that identifies the modification of a resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Organization](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Organization) | class | An organization is a social or legal institution such as a company, society, etc. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Person](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Person) | class | Person agents are people. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Plan](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Plan) | class | A plan is an entity that represents a set of actions or steps intended by one or more agents to achieve some goals. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [PrimarySource](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/PrimarySource) | class | A primary source for a topic refers to something produced by some agent with direct experience and knowledge about the topic, at the time of the topic's study, without benefit from hindsight.<br><br>Because of the directness of primary sources, they 'speak for themselves' in ways that cannot be captured through the filter of secondary sources. As such, it is important for secondary sources to reference those primary sources from which they were derived, so that their reliability can be investigated.<br><br>A primary source relation is a particular case of derivation of secondary materials from their primary sources. It is recognized that the determination of primary sources can be up to interpretation, and should be done according to conventions accepted within the application's domain. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Publish](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Publish) | class | Activity that identifies the publication of a resource |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Publisher](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Publisher) | class | Role with the function of publishing a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a Publish Activity |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Quotation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Quotation) | class | A quotation is the repeat of (some or all of) an entity, such as text or image, by someone who may or may not be its original author. Quotation is a particular case of derivation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Removal](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Removal) | class | Removal is a derivation that describes the transformation of a dictionary into another, by removing one or more keys. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Replace](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Replace) | class | Activity that identifies the replacement of a resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Revision](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Revision) | class | A revision is a derivation for which the resulting entity is a revised version of some original. The implication here is that the resulting entity contains substantial content from the original. Revision is a particular case of derivation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [RightsAssignment](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/RightsAssignment) | class | Activity that identifies the rights assignment of a resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [RightsHolder](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/RightsHolder) | class | Role with the function of owning or managing rights over a resource. The Agent assigned to this role is associated with a RightsAssignment Activity |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Role](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Role) | class | A role is the function of an entity or agent with respect to an activity, in the context of a usage, generation, invalidation, association, start, and end. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [ServiceDescription](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/ServiceDescription) | class | Type for a generic provenance query service. Mainly for use in RDF provenance query service descriptions, to facilitate discovery in linked data environments. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [SoftwareAgent](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/SoftwareAgent) | class | A software agent is running software. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Start](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Start) | class | Start is when an activity is deemed to have been started by an entity, known as trigger. The activity did not exist before its start. Any usage, generation, or invalidation involving an activity follows the activity's start. A start may refer to a trigger entity that set off the activity, or to an activity, known as starter, that generated the trigger. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Submit](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Submit) | class | Activity that identifies the issuance (e.g., publication) of a resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [Usage](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/Usage) | class | Usage is the beginning of utilizing an entity by an activity. Before usage, the activity had not begun to utilize this entity and could not have been affected by the entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [actedOnBehalfOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/actedOnBehalfOf) | object_property | An object property to express the accountability of an agent towards another agent. The subordinate agent acted on behalf of the responsible agent in an actual activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [activity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/activity) | object_property | The prov:activity property references an prov:Activity which influenced a resource. This property applies to an prov:ActivityInfluence, which is given by a subproperty of prov:qualifiedInfluence from the influenced prov:Entity, prov:Activity or prov:Agent. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [agent](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/agent) | object_property | The prov:agent property references an prov:Agent which influenced a resource. This property applies to an prov:AgentInfluence, which is given by a subproperty of prov:qualifiedInfluence from the influenced prov:Entity, prov:Activity or prov:Agent. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [alternateOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/alternateOf) | object_property | Two alternate entities present aspects of the same thing. These aspects may be the same or different, and the alternate entities may or may not overlap in time. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [asInBundle](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/asInBundle) | object_property | prov:asInBundle is used to specify which bundle the general entity of a prov:mentionOf property is described.<br><br>When :x prov:mentionOf :y and :y is described in Bundle :b, the triple :x prov:asInBundle :b is also asserted to cite the Bundle in which :y was described. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [atLocation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/atLocation) | object_property | The Location of any resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [atTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/atTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an InstantaneousEvent occurred, in the form of xsd:dateTime. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [derivedByInsertionFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/derivedByInsertionFrom) | object_property | The dictionary was derived from the other by insertion. Can be qualified with prov:qualifiedInsertion, which shows details of the insertion, in particular the inserted key-entity pairs. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [derivedByRemovalFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/derivedByRemovalFrom) | object_property | The dictionary was derived from the other by removal. Can be qualified with prov:qualifiedRemoval, which shows details of the removal, in particular the removed keys. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [describesService](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/describesService) | object_property | relates a generic provenance query service resource (type prov:ServiceDescription) to a specific query service description (e.g. a prov:DirectQueryService or a sd:Service). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [dictionary](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/dictionary) | object_property | The property used by a prov:Insertion and prov:Removal to cite the prov:Dictionary that was prov:derivedByInsertionFrom or prov:derivedByRemovalFrom another dictionary. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [endedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/endedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an activity ended. See also prov:startedAtTime. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [entity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/entity) | object_property | The prov:entity property references an prov:Entity which influenced a resource. This property applies to an prov:EntityInfluence, which is given by a subproperty of prov:qualifiedInfluence from the influenced prov:Entity, prov:Activity or prov:Agent. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [generated](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/generated) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [generatedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/generatedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an entity was completely created and is available for use. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadActivity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadActivity) | object_property | This property has multiple RDFS domains to suit multiple OWL Profiles. See <a href="#owl-profile">PROV-O OWL Profile</a>. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadDictionaryMember](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadDictionaryMember) | object_property | Describes the key-entity pair that was member of a prov:Dictionary. A dictionary can have multiple members. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadGeneration](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadGeneration) | object_property | The _optional_ Generation involved in an Entity's Derivation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadMember](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadMember) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadPlan](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadPlan) | object_property | The _optional_ Plan adopted by an Agent in Association with some Activity. Plan specifications are out of the scope of this specification. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadPrimarySource](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadPrimarySource) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadRole](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadRole) | object_property | prov:hadRole references the Role (i.e. the function of an entity with respect to an activity), in the context of an instantaneous usage, generation, association, start, and end. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [hadUsage](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/hadUsage) | object_property | The _optional_ Usage involved in an Entity's Derivation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [has_anchor](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/has_anchor) | object_property | Indicates anchor URI for a potentially dynamic resource instance. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [has_provenance](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/has_provenance) | object_property | Indicates a provenance-URI for a resource; the resource identified by this property presents a provenance record about its subject or anchor resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [has_query_service](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/has_query_service) | object_property | Indicates a provenance query service that can access provenance related to its subject or anchor resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [influenced](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/influenced) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [influencer](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/influencer) | object_property | This property is used as part of the qualified influence pattern. Subclasses of prov:Influence use these subproperties to reference the resource (Entity, Agent, or Activity) whose influence is being qualified. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [insertedKeyEntityPair](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/insertedKeyEntityPair) | object_property | An object property to refer to the prov:KeyEntityPair inserted into a prov:Dictionary. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [invalidated](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/invalidated) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [invalidatedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/invalidatedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an entity was invalidated (i.e., no longer usable). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [mentionOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/mentionOf) | object_property | prov:mentionOf is used to specialize an entity as described in another bundle. It is to be used in conjuction with prov:asInBundle.<br><br>prov:asInBundle is used to cite the Bundle in which the generalization was mentioned. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [pairEntity](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/pairEntity) | object_property | The entity of a prov:KeyEntityPair, which is an element of a prov:Dictionary. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [pairKey](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/pairKey) | datatype_property | The key of a prov:KeyEntityPair, which is an element of a prov:Dictionary. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [pingback](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/pingback) | object_property | Relates a resource to a provenance pingback service that may receive additional provenance links about the resource. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [provenanceUriTemplate](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/provenanceUriTemplate) | datatype_property | Relates a provenance service to a URI template string for constructing provenance-URIs. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedAssociation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedAssociation) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasAssociatedWith Agent :ag, then it can qualify the Association using prov:qualifiedAssociation [ a prov:Association; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedAttribution](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedAttribution) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasAttributedTo Agent :ag, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedAttribution [ a prov:Attribution; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedCommunication](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedCommunication) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasInformedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was influenced using prov:qualifiedCommunication [ a prov:Communication; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedDelegation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedDelegation) | object_property | If this Agent prov:actedOnBehalfOf Agent :ag, then it can qualify how with prov:qualifiedResponsibility [ a prov:Responsibility; prov:agent :ag; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedDerivation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedDerivation) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasDerivedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was derived using prov:qualifiedDerivation [ a prov:Derivation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedEnd](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedEnd) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasEndedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was ended using prov:qualifiedEnd [ a prov:End; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedGeneration](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedGeneration) | object_property | If this Activity prov:generated Entity :e, then it can qualify how it performed the Generation using prov:qualifiedGeneration [ a prov:Generation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedInfluence](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedInfluence) | object_property | Because prov:qualifiedInfluence is a broad relation, the more specific relations (qualifiedCommunication, qualifiedDelegation, qualifiedEnd, etc.) should be used when applicable. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedInsertion](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedInsertion) | object_property | prov:qualifiedInsertion shows the details of an insertion, in particular the inserted key-entity pairs. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedInvalidation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedInvalidation) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasInvalidatedBy Activity :a, then it can qualify how it was invalidated using prov:qualifiedInvalidation [ a prov:Invalidation; prov:activity :a; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedPrimarySource](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedPrimarySource) | object_property | If this Entity prov:hadPrimarySource Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedPrimarySource [ a prov:PrimarySource; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedQuotation](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedQuotation) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasQuotedFrom Entity :e, then it can qualify how using prov:qualifiedQuotation [ a prov:Quotation; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedRemoval](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedRemoval) | object_property | prov:qualifiedRemoval shows the details of a removal, in particular the removed keys. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedRevision](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedRevision) | object_property | If this Entity prov:wasRevisionOf Entity :e, then it can qualify how it was revised using prov:qualifiedRevision [ a prov:Revision; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedStart](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedStart) | object_property | If this Activity prov:wasStartedBy Entity :e1, then it can qualify how it was started using prov:qualifiedStart [ a prov:Start; prov:entity :e1; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [qualifiedUsage](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/qualifiedUsage) | object_property | If this Activity prov:used Entity :e, then it can qualify how it used it using prov:qualifiedUsage [ a prov:Usage; prov:entity :e; :foo :bar ]. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [removedKey](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/removedKey) | datatype_property | The key removed in a Removal. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [specializationOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/specializationOf) | object_property | An entity that is a specialization of another shares all aspects of the latter, and additionally presents more specific aspects of the same thing as the latter. In particular, the lifetime of the entity being specialized contains that of any specialization. Examples of aspects include a time period, an abstraction, and a context associated with the entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [startedAtTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/startedAtTime) | datatype_property | The time at which an activity started. See also prov:endedAtTime. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [used](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/used) | object_property | A prov:Entity that was used by this prov:Activity. For example, :baking prov:used :spoon, :egg, :oven . |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [value](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/value) | datatype_property | Provides a value that is a direct representation of an entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasAssociatedWith](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasAssociatedWith) | object_property | An prov:Agent that had some (unspecified) responsibility for the occurrence of this prov:Activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasAttributedTo](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasAttributedTo) | object_property | Attribution is the ascribing of an entity to an agent. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasDerivedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasDerivedFrom) | object_property | A derivation is a transformation of an entity into another, an update of an entity resulting in a new one, or the construction of a new entity based on a pre-existing entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasEndedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasEndedBy) | object_property | End is when an activity is deemed to have ended. An end may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that terminated the activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasGeneratedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasGeneratedBy) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasInfluencedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasInfluencedBy) | object_property | Because prov:wasInfluencedBy is a broad relation, its more specific subproperties (e.g. prov:wasInformedBy, prov:actedOnBehalfOf, prov:wasEndedBy, etc.) should be used when applicable. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasInformedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasInformedBy) | object_property | An activity a2 is dependent on or informed by another activity a1, by way of some unspecified entity that is generated by a1 and used by a2. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasInvalidatedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasInvalidatedBy) | object_property | - |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasQuotedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasQuotedFrom) | object_property | An entity is derived from an original entity by copying, or 'quoting', some or all of it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasRevisionOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasRevisionOf) | object_property | A revision is a derivation that revises an entity into a revised version. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/` | [wasStartedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov/wasStartedBy) | object_property | Start is when an activity is deemed to have started. A start may refer to an entity, known as trigger, that initiated the activity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [ActuatableProperty](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/ActuatableProperty) | class | An actuatable quality (property, characteristic) of a FeatureOfInterest. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Actuation](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Actuation) | class | An Actuation carries out an (Actuation) Procedure to change the state of the world using an Actuator. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Actuator](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Actuator) | class | A device that is used by, or implements, an (Actuation) Procedure that changes the state of the world. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [FeatureOfInterest](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/FeatureOfInterest) | class | The thing whose property is being estimated or calculated in the course of an Observation to arrive at a Result or whose property is being manipulated by an Actuator, or which is being sampled or transformed in an act of Sampling. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [ObservableProperty](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/ObservableProperty) | class | An observable quality (property, characteristic) of a FeatureOfInterest. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Observation](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Observation) | class | Act of carrying out an (Observation) Procedure to estimate or calculate a value of a property of a FeatureOfInterest. Links to a Sensor to describe what made the Observation and how; links to an ObservableProperty to describe what the result is an estimate of, and to a FeatureOfInterest to detail what that property was associated with. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Platform](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Platform) | class | A Platform is an entity that hosts other entities, particularly Sensors, Actuators, Samplers, and other Platforms. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Procedure](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Procedure) | class | A workflow, protocol, plan, algorithm, or computational method specifying how to make an Observation, create a Sample, or make a change to the state of the world (via an Actuator). A Procedure is re-usable, and might be involved in many Observations, Samplings, or Actuations. It explains the steps to be carried out to arrive at reproducible results. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Result](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Result) | class | The Result of an Observation, Actuation, or act of Sampling. To store an observation's simple result value one can use the hasSimpleResult property. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Sample](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Sample) | class | Feature which is intended to be representative of a FeatureOfInterest on which Observations may be made. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Sampler](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Sampler) | class | A device that is used by, or implements, a Sampling Procedure to create or transform one or more samples. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Sampling](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Sampling) | class | An act of Sampling carries out a sampling Procedure to create or transform one or more samples. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [Sensor](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/Sensor) | class | Device, agent (including humans), or software (simulation) involved in, or implementing, a Procedure. Sensors respond to a stimulus, e.g., a change in the environment, or input data composed from the results of prior Observations, and generate a Result. Sensors can be hosted by Platforms. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [actsOnProperty](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/actsOnProperty) | object_property | Relation between an Actuation and the property of a FeatureOfInterest it is acting upon. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [hasFeatureOfInterest](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hasFeatureOfInterest) | object_property | A relation between an Observation and the entity whose quality was observed, or between an Actuation and the entity whose property was modified, or between an act of Sampling and the entity that was sampled. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [hasResult](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hasResult) | object_property | Relation linking an Observation or Actuation or act of Sampling and a Result or Sample. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [hasSample](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hasSample) | object_property | Relation between a FeatureOfInterest and the Sample used to represent it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [hasSimpleResult](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hasSimpleResult) | datatype_property | The simple value of an Observation or Actuation or act of Sampling. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [hosts](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/hosts) | object_property | Relation between a Platform and a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, hosted or mounted on it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [isActedOnBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/isActedOnBy) | object_property | Relation between an ActuatableProperty of a FeatureOfInterest and an Actuation changing its state. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [isFeatureOfInterestOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/isFeatureOfInterestOf) | object_property | A relation between a FeatureOfInterest and an Observation about it, an Actuation acting on it, or an act of Sampling that sampled it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [isHostedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/isHostedBy) | object_property | Relation between a Sensor, Actuator, Sampler, or Platform, and the Platform that it is mounted on or hosted by. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [isObservedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/isObservedBy) | object_property | Relation between an ObservableProperty and the Sensor able to observe it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [isResultOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/isResultOf) | object_property | Relation linking a Result to the Observation or Actuation or act of Sampling that created or caused it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [isSampleOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/isSampleOf) | object_property | Relation from a Sample to the FeatureOfInterest that it is intended to be representative of. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [madeActuation](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/madeActuation) | object_property | Relation between an Actuator and the Actuation it has made. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [madeByActuator](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/madeByActuator) | object_property | Relation linking an Actuation to the Actuator that made that Actuation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [madeBySampler](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/madeBySampler) | object_property | Relation linking an act of Sampling to the Sampler (sampling device or entity) that made it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [madeBySensor](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/madeBySensor) | object_property | Relation between an Observation and the Sensor which made the Observation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [madeObservation](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/madeObservation) | object_property | Relation between a Sensor and an Observation made by the Sensor. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [madeSampling](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/madeSampling) | object_property | Relation between a Sampler (sampling device or entity) and the Sampling act it performed. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [observedProperty](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/observedProperty) | object_property | Relation linking an Observation to the property that was observed. The ObservableProperty should be a property of the FeatureOfInterest (linked by hasFeatureOfInterest) of this Observation. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [observes](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/observes) | object_property | Relation between a Sensor and an ObservableProperty that it is capable of sensing. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [phenomenonTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/phenomenonTime) | object_property | The time that the Result of an Observation, Actuation or Sampling applies to the FeatureOfInterest. Not necessarily the same as the resultTime. May be an Interval or an Instant, or some other compound TemporalEntity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [resultTime](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/resultTime) | datatype_property | The result time is the instant of time when the Observation, Actuation or Sampling activity was completed. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/` | [usedProcedure](http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/usedProcedure) | object_property | A relation to link to a re-usable Procedure used in making an Observation, an Actuation, or a Sample, typically through a Sensor, Actuator or Sampler. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [Deployment](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/Deployment) | class | Describes the Deployment of one or more Systems for a particular purpose. Deployment may be done on a Platform. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [Input](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/Input) | class | Any information that is provided to a Procedure for its use. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [Output](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/Output) | class | Any information that is reported from a Procedure. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [Property](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/Property) | class | A quality of an entity. An aspect of an entity that is intrinsic to and cannot exist without the entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [Stimulus](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/Stimulus) | class | An event in the real world that 'triggers' the Sensor. The properties associated to the Stimulus may be different to the eventual observed ObservableProperty. It is the event, not the object, that triggers the Sensor. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [System](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/System) | class | System is a unit of abstraction for pieces of infrastructure that implement Procedures. A System may have components, its subsystems, which are other systems. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [deployedOnPlatform](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/deployedOnPlatform) | object_property | Relation between a Deployment and the Platform on which the Systems are deployed. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [deployedSystem](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/deployedSystem) | object_property | Relation between a Deployment and a deployed System. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [detects](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/detects) | object_property | A relation from a Sensor to the Stimulus that the Sensor detects. The Stimulus itself will be serving as a proxy for some ObservableProperty. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [forProperty](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/forProperty) | object_property | A relation between some aspect of an entity and a Property. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [hasDeployment](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/hasDeployment) | object_property | Relation between a System and a Deployment, recording that the System is deployed in that Deployment. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [hasInput](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/hasInput) | object_property | Relation between a Procedure and an Input to it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [hasOutput](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/hasOutput) | object_property | Relation between a Procedure and an Output of it. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [hasProperty](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/hasProperty) | object_property | Relation between an entity and a Property of that entity. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [hasSubSystem](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/hasSubSystem) | object_property | Relation between a System and its component parts. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [implementedBy](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/implementedBy) | object_property | Relation between a Procedure (an algorithm, procedure or method) and an entity that implements that Procedure in some executable way. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [implements](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/implements) | object_property | Relation between an entity that implements a Procedure in some executable way and the Procedure (an algorithm, procedure or method). |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [inDeployment](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/inDeployment) | object_property | Relation between a Platform and a Deployment, meaning that the deployedSystems of the Deployment are hosted on the Platform. |
| `http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/` | [isPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/ns/ssn/isPropertyOf) | object_property | Relation between a Property and the entity it belongs to. |

| `https://w3id.org/citydata/part1/v1/` | [Activity](https://w3id.org/citydata/part1/v1/Activity) | class | An Activity describes something that occurs in the domain.<br>An Activity may be further defined by (decomposed into) Subactivities.<br>An Activity may have precondition and/or effect State.<br>An Activity may be enabled by or cause some State. An enabling of causing state is a generalization of a precondition/effect; an Activity is enabled by or causes some State if it has a subactivity with a precondition or effect (respectively) of that State.<br>In other words, the state may not be required directly before, or cause directly after the activity, but by some more specialized sub-activity.<br>An Activity occurs at some point in time and space.<br>An Activity takes place during some interval, and so has some duration.<br>An Activity may have some Manifestations that participate in it. |

An agreement may be defined at varying levels of detail, this is supported with the introduction of the ComplexAgreement and AtomicAgreement class. Finally, agreements involve some specification of rights or commitments of the involved parties. This is represented as a relationship between the involved Agent and a particular activity. |

| `https://w3id.org/citydata/part1/v1/` | [State](https://w3id.org/citydata/part1/v1/State) | class | A State describes some situation in the world which may or may not be satisfied (true) at a given point in time. A State refers to a class of manifestations. It may be a precondition or effect of some Activity, or more generally it may be enabled or be caused by some Activity. If a state is complex, it may refer to some combination of classes of manifestations.<br>Example: A shopping activity, Activity-Shop, can require both the VehicleW30LGas state, but also some state wherein the mall is open, OpenMall. Each state is defined separately. The combined state is then defined as the conjunction of the two states. Thus, we could say that the preconditions for Activity-Shop are: precondition(VehicleW30LGas,Activity-Shop) AND precondition(OpenMall,Activity-Shop). Alternatively, if the preconditions were required disjunctively, we could state: precondition(VehicleW30LGas,Activity-Shop) OR precondition(OpenMall,Activity-Shop).<br>In large and complex domains, there can be cases in which the above approach is undesirable. In particular, due to the complexity of the description that results as the state being described becomes more detailed. In many cases it will be more natural and convenient to be able to refer to a single, aggregate state. We therefore extend the representation of States to capture aggregation, as approached in the concept of state trees introduced by TOVE as a construct for the activity cluster.<br>A State may be either non-terminal or terminal. A terminal state has no child states, and therefore refers directly to a class of manifestations, whereas a non-terminal state has child states, which may define some classes of manifestations, or further define some other complex states.<br>NonTerminalState(x) v TerminalState(x) = State(x)<br>A state cannot be both non-terminal and terminal.<br>TerminalState disjointWith NonTerminalState |

Most of the features of the transport alert pattern can also be used for other types of alerts (e.g., meteorological events) and as such, its design includes the definition of a generalized alert. |

| `https://w3id.org/citydata/part3/v1/` | [TransportNetworkObjectProperty](https://w3id.org/citydata/part3/v1/TransportNetworkObjectProperty) | object_property | Added for organizational purposes, to identify all object properties defined in the Transport Network Pattern. |
| `https://w3id.org/citydata/part3/v1/` | [TransportNetworkThing](https://w3id.org/citydata/part3/v1/TransportNetworkThing) | class | The Transport Network Pattern models the core concepts involved in describing a transport network. This includes an identification of both physical and administrative characteristics. The most general class is that of the NetworkElement, which can be further classified as one of several types of NetworkElements. A key feature of this pattern is the formalization of the hasProperPart relationship from a NetworkElement to another NetworkElement. This allows for a representation of networks at multiple levels of detail. For example, at one level, a motorway interchange can be modelled as a single Node. But that node is a NetworkElement that can be defined to consist of an entire TransportNetwork that has a node for each junction within the interchange. |
